items.source: Applies this function to the given arguments.
items.translation: 将此函数应用于给定参数。

items.source: T - the type of the first argument to the function.
items.translation: T - 函数的第一个参数的类型。

items.source: R - the type of the result of the function.
items.translation: R - 函数的返回结果类型。

items.source: Represents a function that accepts two arguments of the same base type and produces a result while the second argument is an array of T. This is similar to a BiFunction but restricts both arguments to be of the same type. Typically used in arrangements where a composite collection of keys is split into the first key and the remaining keys.
items.translation: 表示一个接受两个相同基元类型参数并产生结果的函数，其中第二个参数是 T 类型的数组。这与 BiFunction 类似，但限制两个参数必须为同一类型。通常用于将复合键集合拆分为第一个键和剩余键的场景中。
